Lieutenant General Vladimir Alexeyev, the deputy head of the GRU, was shot and severely injured by an unidentified gunman in Moscow.

Five drones were shot down as they approached Moscow, according to the city's mayor, with Domodedovo and Sheremetyevo airports suspending flights. An airbase near Yeysk was attacked, with drones damaging a Ka-27 and destroying a Be-200.
